# Ruth

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Ruth tells a story of loyalty, redemption, and God's providence through ordinary lives. The book teaches that God works faithfully behind the scenes to accomplish His redemptive purposes.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Ruth 1:16</div>

<div class="identifier">Whither thou goest, I will go</div>

### Why This Verse

Most famous verse in Ruth

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Naomi's loss and Ruth's decision to remain with her. The key verse demonstrates covenant loyalty, faithfulness, and commitment to God despite hardship.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Ruth 2:12</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD recompense thy work</div>

### Why This Verse

Boaz's blessing

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Ruth's providential encounter with Boaz. The key verse highlights God's unseen guidance and provision through the kindness of others.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Ruth 3:11</div>

<div class="identifier">All the city knows you are virtuous</div>

### Why This Verse

Ruth's character affirmed

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Ruth's appeal to Boaz as kinsman-redeemer. The key verse emphasizes redemption, protection, and faithful obedience to God's design.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Ruth 4:17</div>

<div class="identifier">A son born to Naomi</div>

### Why This Verse

Connects Ruth to David's lineage

### Chapter Insight

This chapter concludes with Boaz redeeming Ruth and establishing a family line. The key verse reveals God's sovereign plan in bringing forth the lineage of King David and ultimately the Messiah.
:::
